agave-nectar.name: Agave Nectar
agave-nectar.notes: Fructose-rich syrup from agave plants. Highly fermentable with mild neutral honey-like character.

brown-sugar.name: Brown Sugar
brown-sugar.notes: Sucrose with molasses content. Contributes subtle rum, caramel, and toffee character in stouts and winter warmers.

candi-sugar.name: Candi Sugar
candi-sugar.notes: Crystallized beet sugar popular in Belgian brewing. Lightens body while increasing ABV without harsh hot-alcohol bite.

candi-syrup.name: Candi Syrup
candi-syrup.notes: Caramelized invert sugar syrup essential for Belgian Dubbels and Dark Strong Ales. Imparts rich dark fruit, toffee, and plum.

cane-sugar.name: Cane Sugar
cane-sugar.notes: Pure sucrose from sugar cane. 100% fermentable, commonly used to dry out high-gravity Belgian tripels and strong ales.

caramel.name: Caramel
caramel.notes: Caramelized culinary sugar offering rich burnt sugar notes and golden-brown hue.

corn-sugar.name: Corn Sugar
corn-sugar.notes: 100% fermentable D-glucose (dextrose). Ideal for bottle priming and boosting gravity while drying out IPAs and strong ales.

corn-syrup.name: Corn Syrup
corn-syrup.notes: Liquid glucose syrup used to boost gravity and lighten body in light lagers and IPAs.

honey.name: Honey
honey.notes: Natural unpasteurized bee honey. High in fructose and glucose; adds delicate floral aroma and crisp dryness when added late.

lactose-milk-sugar.name: Lactose (Milk Sugar)
lactose-milk-sugar.notes: Unfermentable milk sugar by brewer's yeast. Retains permanent residual sweetness, milky mouthfeel, and body in Milk Stouts and Pastry Sours.

maltodextrin.name: Maltodextrin
maltodextrin.notes: Non-sweet unfermentable complex polysaccharide. Enhances body, head retention, and viscosity without adding sweetness.

maple-syrup.name: Maple Syrup
maple-syrup.notes: Boiled maple sap syrup. Delivers distinct earthy woody sweetness and delicate maple aroma in dark ales and porters.

molasses.name: Molasses
molasses.notes: Cane sugar refining byproduct. Delivers bold pungent dark sugar, licorice, rum, and burnt molasses flavor in imperial stouts.

rice-syrup.name: Rice Syrup
rice-syrup.notes: Fermentable syrup made from cultured rice. Enhances crisp dry finish in lagers.

sorghum-syrup.name: Sorghum Syrup
sorghum-syrup.notes: Key ingredient in gluten-free brewing. Liquid extract from sweet sorghum cane yielding herbal, citrusy, and sweet notes.

sugar.name: Sugar
sugar.notes: Standard granulated white table sugar (sucrose). Ferments completely leaving zero residual sweetness or color.

turbinado.name: Turbinado
turbinado.notes: Raw cane sugar with light molasses remnants providing soft honey-like sweetness and delicate caramel color.
